title: Correct the --json coverage claim in docs/agents.md
lead: `docs/agents.md` says "Every subcommand except the interactive `tui`/`ui` accepts `--json`". The git merge drivers `merge-index` and `merge-relay-roles` do not accept it either (`slicer merge-index --help` lists no `--json`). This slice makes the sentence name them.
findings_note: orchestrator, 2026-10-14: docs/agents.md says every subcommand but tui/ui takes --json; merge-index and merge-relay-roles do not
boundary: Not in this slice: adding --json to the merge drivers or to tui/ui, and any other docs/agents.md change.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Found by the orchestrator on 2026-10-14 while checking s269's claims. An agent that trusts the sentence and passes `--json` to a merge driver gets a usage error. Git invokes the drivers, so the fix is the doc, not the drivers.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_AgentsDoc_JsonExceptions_MatchParser`: the commands the parser builds without a `--json` option equal the exceptions the sentence names.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test and watch it go red.
2. Reword the sentence to name `tui`, `ui` and the git merge drivers `merge-index` and `merge-relay-roles`.
3. Add a CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry under Fixed.
4. Mutation-check the test by adding `--json` to one merge driver's parser in a scratch copy.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `tests/test_docs_coverage.py` passes, and the full suite passes on Python 3.11+.
- `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s272`, branch `feature/s272-json-claim`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
